definitions.explanation: The design or practice of letting natural light into a building through windows, skylights, or other openings. An important consideration in architecture and interior design.

examples.japanese: {採光|さいこう}のいい{部屋|へや}だ。
examples.english: This room has good natural lighting.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{窓|まど}で{採光|さいこう}を{確保|かくほ}した。
examples.english: Large windows ensure sufficient natural lighting.

examples.japanese: この{設計|せっけい}は{採光|さいこう}と{換気|かんき}を{両立|りょうりつ}させている。
examples.english: This design achieves both natural lighting and ventilation.

notes:
{採光|さいこう} combines {採|さい} (to gather) and {光|こう} (light) — literally "gathering light."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {採光|さいこう}がいい/わるい — good/poor natural lighting
- {採光|さいこう}を{確保|かくほ}する — to secure natural lighting
- {採光|さいこう}{窓|まど} — window for natural lighting

In Japanese building regulations, residential rooms must meet minimum {採光|さいこう} standards. Real estate listings frequently mention {採光|さいこう} as a selling point, especially for south-facing rooms ({南向|みなみむ}き).
